mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT UPPER(TRIM(symbol)) FROM quant_order WHERE credential_id=#{credentialId} AND symbol IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(symbol)<>'' ORDER BY UPPER(TRIM(symbol))
mapper.update: UPDATE quant_order SET post_fill_balance_requested_at=#{requestedAt} WHERE id=#{id} AND (post_fill_balance_requested_at IS NULL OR post_fill_balance_requested_at < TIMESTAMPADD(SECOND, -30, UTC_TIMESTAMP()))
UPDATE quant_order SET post_fill_wallet_balance=#{balance}, post_fill_balance_at=#{observedAt} WHERE id=#{id}

UPDATE quant_order SET exchange_order_id=COALESCE(exchange_order_id, #{fact.exchangeOrderId}), client_order_id=CASE WHEN client_order_id LIKE 'EXCHANGE:%' AND #{fact.clientOrderId} NOT LIKE 'EXCHANGE:%' THEN #{fact.clientOrderId} ELSE client_order_id END, symbol=#{fact.symbol}, side=COALESCE(#{fact.side},side), order_type=COALESCE(#{fact.orderType},order_type), status=COALESCE(#{fact.status},status), price=COALESCE(#{fact.price},price), original_quantity=COALESCE(#{fact.originalQuantity},original_quantity), executed_quantity=COALESCE(#{fact.executedQuantity},executed_quantity), leverage_snapshot=COALESCE(leverage_snapshot, #{fact.leverageSnapshot}), price_tick_size_snapshot=COALESCE(price_tick_size_snapshot, #{fact.priceTickSizeSnapshot}), strategy_id=COALESCE(strategy_id, #{fact.strategyId}), strategy_instance_id=COALESCE(strategy_instance_id, #{fact.strategyInstanceId}), position_side=CASE WHEN position_side IS NULL OR TRIM(position_side)='' THEN #{fact.positionSide} ELSE position_side END, reduce_only=COALESCE(reduce_only, #{fact.reduceOnly}), updated_at=#{fact.updatedAt} WHERE id=#{fact.id} AND credential_id=#{fact.credentialId} AND (exchange_order_id IS NULL OR #{fact.exchangeOrderId} IS NULL OR exchange_order_id=#{fact.exchangeOrderId}) AND (client_order_id=#{fact.clientOrderId} OR client_order_id LIKE 'EXCHANGE:%' OR #{fact.clientOrderId} LIKE 'EXCHANGE:%') AND (strategy_id IS NULL OR #{fact.strategyId} IS NULL OR strategy_id=#{fact.strategyId}) AND (strategy_instance_id IS NULL OR #{fact.strategyInstanceId} IS NULL OR strategy_instance_id=#{fact.strategyInstanceId}) AND (position_side IS NULL OR TRIM(position_side)='' OR #{fact.positionSide} IS NULL OR position_side=#{fact.positionSide}) AND (reduce_only IS NULL OR #{fact.reduceOnly} IS NULL OR reduce_only=#{fact.reduceOnly}) AND (executed_quantity IS NULL OR (#{fact.executedQuantity} IS NOT NULL AND executed_quantity<=#{fact.executedQuantity})) AND (status IS NULL OR status NOT IN ('FILLED','CANCELED','EXPIRED','EXPIRED_IN_MATCH','REJECTED') OR status=#{fact.status}) AND (status IS NULL OR status NOT IN ('PARTIALLY_FILLED','PENDING_CANCEL') OR #{fact.status} NOT IN ('NEW','PENDING_NEW'))
